# يُقْلَعَفُّ (yuqlaʕaffu) /juq.la.ʕaf.fu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
# يَقْلَعِفَّ (yaqlaʕiffa) /jaq.la.ʕif.fa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْلَع
